description: Change title, description or privacy of a playlist (playlist_id, or playlist_title to find it). privacy 'public' is ALWAYS parked for approval and runs only after a human admin approves it - in the app, or on the human's explicit request via resolve_pending_tool_call {human_request} with their own API key (never as an agent). Never deletes.

channel_id.description: YouTube channel id (UC…) from list_youtube_channels; optional when only one channel is connected

playlist_id.description: ID of the playlist to change

playlist_title.description: Find the playlist by this exact title (when no playlist_id is given)

privacy.description: New visibility; public is always parked for admin approval

name: update_youtube_playlist
